Decision.AttributionNote: 東山破峰重禪師語錄, hall address raising Cuiyan's end-of-retreat eyebrow case. Pofeng Puzhong is the exact framing and commenting speaker: after quoting Cuiyan, Changqing, Baofu, and Yunmen, he says Cuiyan cannot save himself where his eyebrows fall out and then tests his own assembly.
